texts.NIV84: My son, keep my words and store up my commands within you.
texts.KJV: My son, keep my words, and lay up my commandments with thee.
texts.NKJV:
My son, keep my words,
And treasure my commands within you.
texts.DRB: My son, keep my words, and lay up my precepts with thee. Son,

texts.NIV84: Keep my commands and you will live; guard my teachings as the apple of your eye.
texts.KJV: Keep my commandments, and live; and my law as the apple of thine eye.
texts.NKJV:
Keep my commands and live,
And my law as the apple of your eye.
texts.DRB: Keep my commandments, and thou shalt live: and my law as the apple of thy eye:

texts.NIV84: Bind them on your fingers; write them on the tablet of your heart.
texts.KJV: Bind them upon thy fingers, write them upon the table of thine heart.
texts.NKJV:
Bind them on your fingers;
Write them on the tablet of your heart.
texts.DRB: Bind it upon thy fingers, write it upon the tables of thy heart.

texts.NIV84: Say to wisdom, "You are my sister," and call understanding your kinsman;
texts.KJV: Say unto wisdom, Thou art my sister; and call understanding thy kinswoman:
texts.NKJV:
Say to wisdom, “You are my sister,”
And call understanding your nearest kin,
texts.DRB: Say to wisdom: Thou art my sister: and call prudence thy friend,

texts.NIV84: they will keep you from the adulteress, from the wayward wife with her seductive words.
texts.KJV: That they may keep thee from the strange woman, from the stranger which flattereth with her words.
texts.NKJV:
That they may keep you from the immoral woman,
From the seductress who flatters with her words.
texts.DRB: That she may keep thee from the woman that is not thine, and from the stranger who sweeteneth her words.

texts.NIV84: At the window of my house I looked out through the lattice.
texts.KJV: For at the window of my house I looked through my casement,
texts.NKJV:
For at the window of my house
I looked through my lattice,
texts.DRB: For I look out of the window of my house through the lattice,

texts.NIV84: I saw among the simple, I noticed among the young men, a youth who lacked judgment.
texts.KJV: And beheld among the simple ones, I discerned among the youths, a young man void of understanding,
texts.NKJV:
And saw among the simple,
I perceived among the youths,
A young man devoid of understanding,
texts.DRB: And I see little ones, I behold a foolish young man,

texts.NIV84: He was going down the street near her corner, walking along in the direction of her house
texts.KJV: Passing through the street near her corner; and he went the way to her house,
texts.NKJV:
Passing along the street near her corner;
And he took the path to her house
texts.DRB: Who passeth through the street by the corner, and goeth nigh the way of her house.

texts.NIV84: at twilight, as the day was fading, as the dark of night set in.
texts.KJV: In the twilight, in the evening, in the black and dark night:
texts.NKJV:
In the twilight, in the evening,
In the black and dark night.
texts.DRB: In the dark, when it grows late, in the darkness and obscurity of the night,

texts.NIV84: Then out came a woman to meet him, dressed like a prostitute and with crafty intent.
texts.KJV: And, behold, there met him a woman with the attire of an harlot, and subtil of heart.
texts.NKJV:
And there a woman met him,
With the attire of a harlot, and a crafty heart.
texts.DRB: And behold a woman meeteth him in harlot's attire prepared to deceive souls; talkative and wandering,

texts.NIV84: (She is loud and defiant, her feet never stay at home;
texts.KJV: (She is loud and stubborn; her feet abide not in her house:
texts.NKJV:
She was loud and rebellious,
Her feet would not stay at home.
texts.DRB: Not bearing to be quiet, not able to abide still at home,

texts.NIV84: now in the street, now in the squares, at every corner she lurks.)
texts.KJV: Now is she without, now in the streets, and lieth in wait at every corner.)
texts.NKJV:
At times she was outside, at times in the open square,
Lurking at every corner.
texts.DRB: Now abroad, now in the streets, now lying in wait near the corners.

texts.NIV84: She took hold of him and kissed him and with a brazen face she said:
texts.KJV: So she caught him, and kissed him, and with an impudent face said unto him,
texts.NKJV:
So she caught him and kissed him;
With an impudent face she said to him:
texts.DRB: And catching the young man, she kisseth him, and with an impudent face, flattereth, saying:

texts.NIV84: "I have fellowship offerings at home; today I fulfilled my vows.
texts.KJV: I have peace offerings with me; this day have I payed my vows.
texts.NKJV:
“I have peace offerings with me;
Today I have paid my vows.
texts.DRB: I vowed victims for prosperity, this day I have paid my vows.

texts.NIV84: So I came out to meet you; I looked for you and have found you!
texts.KJV: Therefore came I forth to meet thee, diligently to seek thy face, and I have found thee.
texts.NKJV:
So I came out to meet you,
Diligently to seek your face,
And I have found you.
texts.DRB: Therefore I am come out to meet thee, desirous to see thee, and I have found thee.

texts.NIV84: I have covered my bed with colored linens from Egypt.
texts.KJV: I have decked my bed with coverings of tapestry, with carved works, with fine linen of Egypt.
texts.NKJV:
I have spread my bed with tapestry,
Colored coverings of Egyptian linen.
texts.DRB: I have woven my bed with cords, I have covered it with painted tapestry, brought from Egypt.

texts.NIV84: I have perfumed my bed with myrrh, aloes and cinnamon.
texts.KJV: I have perfumed my bed with myrrh, aloes, and cinnamon.
texts.NKJV:
I have perfumed my bed
With myrrh, aloes, and cinnamon.
texts.DRB: I have perfumed my bed with myrrh, aloes, and cinnamon.

texts.NIV84: Come, let's drink deep of love till morning; let's enjoy ourselves with love!
texts.KJV: Come, let us take our fill of love until the morning: let us solace ourselves with loves.
texts.NKJV:
Come, let us take our fill of love until morning;
Let us delight ourselves with love.
texts.DRB: Come, let us be inebriated with the breasts, and let us enjoy the desired embraces, till the day appear.

texts.NIV84: My husband is not at home; he has gone on a long journey.
texts.KJV: For the goodman is not at home, he is gone a long journey:
texts.NKJV:
For my husband is not at home;
He has gone on a long journey;
texts.DRB: For my husband is not at home, he is gone a very long journey.

texts.NIV84: He took his purse filled with money and will not be home till full moon."
texts.KJV: He hath taken a bag of money with him, and will come home at the day appointed.
texts.NKJV:
He has taken a bag of money with him,
And will come home on the appointed day.”
texts.DRB: He took with him a bag of money: he mill return home the day of the full moon.

texts.NIV84: With persuasive words she led him astray; she seduced him with her smooth talk.
texts.KJV: With her much fair speech she caused him to yield, with the flattering of her lips she forced him.
texts.NKJV:
With her enticing speech she caused him to yield,
With her flattering lips she seduced him.
texts.DRB: She entangled him with many words, and drew him away with the flattery of her lips.

texts.NIV84: All at once he followed her like an ox going to the slaughter, like a deer stepping into a noose
texts.KJV: He goeth after her straightway, as an ox goeth to the slaughter, or as a fool to the correction of the stocks;
texts.NKJV:
Immediately he went after her, as an ox goes to the slaughter,
Or as a fool to the correction of the stocks,
texts.DRB: Immediately he followeth her as an ox led to be a victim, and as a lamb playing the wanton, and not knowing that he is drawn like a fool to bonds,

texts.NIV84: till an arrow pierces his liver, like a bird darting into a snare, little knowing it will cost him his life.
texts.KJV: Till a dart strike through his liver; as a bird hasteth to the snare, and knoweth not that it is for his life.
texts.NKJV:
Till an arrow struck his liver.
As a bird hastens to the snare,
He did not know it would cost his life.
texts.DRB: Till the arrow pierce his liver: as if a bird should make haste to the snare, and knoweth not that his life is in danger.

texts.NIV84: Now then, my sons, listen to me; pay attention to what I say.
texts.KJV: Hearken unto me now therefore, O ye children, and attend to the words of my mouth.
texts.NKJV:
Now therefore, listen to me, my children;
Pay attention to the words of my mouth:
texts.DRB: Now therefore, my son, hear me, and attend to the words of my mouth.

texts.NIV84: Do not let your heart turn to her ways or stray into her paths.
texts.KJV: Let not thine heart decline to her ways, go not astray in her paths.
texts.NKJV:
Do not let your heart turn aside to her ways,
Do not stray into her paths;
texts.DRB: Let not thy mind be drawn away in her ways: neither be thou deceived with her paths.

texts.NIV84: Many are the victims she has brought down; her slain are a mighty throng.
texts.KJV: For she hath cast down many wounded: yea, many strong men have been slain by her.
texts.NKJV:
For she has cast down many wounded,
And all who were slain by her were strong men.
texts.DRB: For she hath cast down many wounded, and the strongest have been slain by her.

texts.NIV84: Her house is a highway to the grave, leading down to the chambers of death.
texts.KJV: Her house is the way to hell, going down to the chambers of death.
texts.NKJV:
Her house is the way to hell,
Descending to the chambers of death.
texts.DRB: Her house is the way to hell, reaching even to the inner chambers of death.
